title: Helpdesk update promise evidence research: testing whether checkpoints remain true
excerpt: Research on event-based customer updates, changing owners, and the record evidence needed to keep support promises accurate.
question: When a helpdesk update names a future event, what evidence shows that the promise remains accurate after facts or ownership change?
focus: customer-facing checkpoints, observable events, and promise changes
finding: a durable update names an observable event and current owner, while an elapsed-time assurance can become misleading when the investigation changes
limitation: public service guidance cannot measure customer understanding or channel visibility
